headline: Google is testing Carbon, a newer internal version of its Gemini 4 AI model, which one employee says codes about as well as Anthropic's Opus 5.5.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered by 2: a repeat of the Business Insider report we carried on 10 Oct 2026 with no new fact.
importance_line: It shows Google trying to close the coding gap with Anthropic and OpenAI, which matters to developers choosing tools, but it rests on employees' impressions of an unreleased model and Google has not said whether Carbon will ship.
summary: Business Insider reports, as relayed by BW People, that Google is testing Carbon, an internal version of Gemini 4, on its internal coding platform Jetski, and that one employee said its coding felt comparable to Anthropic's Opus 5.5 while adding that more testing is needed. This repeats the Business Insider report of 9 Oct 2026 that we carried in our 10 Oct 2026 edition; BW People adds only that a second employee also praised the model, and Google has not said whether Carbon will be released or under what name.
notes: Read BW People (a rewrite of Business Insider); the Business Insider link is taken from our 10 Oct 2026 entry, which read the original. Repeat of our 10 Oct 2026 entry C01-02 with no new fact: recommend dropping at the 14-day duplicate check.
